Chat.extraInfo:
## Common Q&A Errors

### Third-Party Service Errors
A third-party service error occurs when an API of a third-party service is configured in a Q&A pair or Dialog Studio. When a user query matches the configured conditions or utterances, the corresponding third-party service is invoked. If the service invocation fails, the system returns the error message "Third party interface error". The response protocol is as follows.

**Response Parameter Description**

| Column Name | Description                                                         |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| RequestId   | Request ID                                                          |
| HostId      | Alibaba Cloud Chatbot host ID                                       |
| Code        | Error code; for third-party service errors, the error code is "Third party interface error" |
| Message     | Fault description                                                   |

**Sample Response Parameters**
```json
{
    "RequestId": "A805905D-B20C-57C9-8793-EAF98FBD8F84",
    "HostId": "chatbot.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com",
    "Code": "Third party interface error",
    "Message": "Third-party interface error. An IOException occurred during the HTTP request, which may be caused by a network connection timeout, no response from the server-side, or other configuration issues. URL: https://example.com/order/create",
    "Recommend": "https://next.api.aliyun.com/troubleshoot?q=Third party interface error&product=Chatbot"
}
```
